baseline_statistic: per-metric 95th percentile of worst pair within each calibration pose
finite_sample_uncertainty: 95% bootstrap upper confidence bound; resample whole pose clusters, 1000 draws
energy_margin_reason: Half of the former 1dB engineering budget; allows 12.2% energy / 5.9% pressure discretization variation, while known 3/6dB faults must fail. Not fitted to the fixed80 test.
arrival_margin_reason: Two 16kHz samples allow endpoint and interpolated first-arrival quantization. The first-arrival measurement is e3dc246; no late-peak search.

crossfade_candidate.reason: The rejected direct-only equal-power candidate produced a coherent-reflection +3dB bump. Use endpoint correlation: rho=1 gives linear weights; rho=0 gives constant-power normalized-linear weights. Twenty milliseconds pools 320 W samples while remaining shorter than the 0.25s trajectory interval. One scalar envelope is shared by all FOA channels. No native RIR normalization, per-channel gain, midpoint fitting, or target waveform is used. Negative correlation is clipped to zero to cap amplification at sqrt(2); independently failed intervals must be refined.

qualified_acoustic_candidate.qualification_scope: two measured HM3D houses, fixed80 and independent baseline/control cases; full QA/assets remain separately blocked
